title: CAI Calls for Removal of Import Duty to Boost Cotton Industry
description: The Cotton Association of India has urged the government to remove the 11% import duty on raw cotton imports. High domestic prices, resulting from low production and high minimum support price, are affecting the competitiveness of Indian textile goods against countries like Vietnam, Bangladesh, and Pakistan.

title: India to deploy home-grown integrated air-defence system to protect Delhi-NCR
description: The project is being processed by the Defence Ministry at a time when Pakistan apparently tried to target the country during the Operation Sindoor in May this year.

title: Is IPL too long? Pakistan's Wasim Akram takes dig at Indian league, says ‘kids grow up, but the league keeps running'
description: The 2025 IPL season started on 22 March with the final initially scheduled for 25 May. But the India-Pakistan border tensions forced a seven-day delay, and it ended on 3 June. In 2026, the IPL is likely to start in March after T20 World Cup.

title: Pak played it right, India faced tariffs for countering Trump: Raghuram Rajan
description: Former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India Raghuram Rajan said that the US's imposition of a 50% tariff on India had less to do with the purchase of Russian oil. He added that the tariffs had more to do with Trump's personality as India contradicted the US President's claim of brokering peace during the four-day mini-war with Pakistan. Adding that, "Pakistan played well", Rajan said that it was the reason why India got a 50% tariff and Pakistan got just 16%.

title: Shahid Afridi mocks Gautam Gambhir; backs Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma for ODI World Cup 2027
description: The enduring feud between former Pakistan captain Shahid Afridi and India’s head coach Gautam Gambhir has flared up again. Afridi offered unequivocal support for Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma for the ODI World Cup 2027 cycle.

title: Closed Skies: The Political Tug-of-War in Aviation
description: IATA's Chief Willie Walsh criticized the closure of airspace for political reasons, which affects global airlines, particularly between India and Pakistan. After a terror incident, India closed its airspace to Pakistani operators, and vice versa. Walsh advocates for open airspace without political or economic influence.
